note: THE GOLDEN CASES. Every one is a real place that went wrong or right for a reason worth remembering. A matching rule that breaks any of these does not get to write answer keys (kpc_us_key.py checks on start-up) and must not be pushed (run python3 tests/run_match_tests.py first). Add a case whenever a wrong join or a wrong alert is found and fixed - with the story in 'why' - so it can never come back. Fable's review, Oct 22: 'keep a golden file of the known cases ... the next rule change will break something old otherwise; it is only a matter of which one.'

us_names.why: Oct 22. 'refuge' was stripped from the front of Refuge Cove as if it were the kind of place, and the two coves collided.
The type word at the END is the kind of place; must still strip normally.

us_names.a: Upper White Oak Lake Recreation Area
us_names.why: Oct 22. Upper and Lower White Oak Lake had BOTH joined the one White Oak Lake State Park.

us_names.a: Lower White Oak Lake State Recreation Area
us_names.why: Oct 22, the other half of the same mistake.
Leading 'Lake' is part of the name and must survive.

us_names.why: Oct 21. A Beaver Creek notice from the Daniel Boone forest landed on Beaver Lake, 150 miles away. Sharing 'Beaver' is not enough.
The club's campout park; the plainest case there is.

alerts.title: Green River Ferry Temporarily Out of Service
alerts.text: The Green River Ferry has temporarily suspended operation due to low water levels.
alerts.why: Oct 21. The Mammoth Cave ferry notice was attached to Green River State Forest AND Green River Lake State Park.

alerts.title: Beaver Creek Wilderness Prohibitions
alerts.text: Within Beaver Creek Wilderness, the following acts are prohibited.
alerts.why: Oct 21. Daniel Boone's Beaver Creek Wilderness was attached to Beaver Lake (US-13598) in Anderson County.

alerts.title: Taylorsville Lake campground closed
alerts.text: The campground at Taylorsville Lake State Park is closed for the season.
alerts.why: A real closure must still reach the right park.

alerts.title: Carter Caves closed

alerts.why: Same, with 'Resort' in the official name.
